description_en: Queries scaling rules. When you call this operation, you can specify the ID, name, or Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of a scaling rule to query the details of the scaling rule. For example, you can query the adjustment method, instance warm-up period, and associated event-triggered tasks of the desired scaling rule
description_zh: 调用DescribeScalingRules并指定伸缩规则ID、伸缩规则名称、伸缩规则唯一标识符等参数，查询伸缩规则及其详细信息。例如，伸缩规则的调整方式、实例预热时间、伸缩规则关联的报警任务信息等
kebab_example: aliyun ess describe-scaling-rules --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 50 --scaling-group-id asg-bp1ffogfdauy0jw00000 --scaling-rule-type SimpleScalingRule --show-alarm-rules false --scaling-rule-ids asr-bp1dvirgwkoowxk70000 --scaling-rule-names scalingrule0000 --scaling-rule-aris ari:acs:ess:cn-hangzhou:1406926474060000:scalingrule/asr-bp1dvirgwkoowxk70000 --api-version 2022-02-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeScalingRules

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group to which the scaling rules that you want to query belong
parameters.help_zh: 伸缩规则所属伸缩组的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The page number. Pages start from page 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩规则列表的页码，起始值：1。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值：50。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the scaling rule. Valid values:

SimpleScalingRule: adjusts the number of ECS instances based on the values of the AdjustmentType and AdjustmentValue parameters.
TargetTrackingScalingRule: calculates the number of ECS instances that need to be scaled in a dynamic manner and maintains the value of a predefined metric close to the value of the TargetValue parameter.
StepScalingRule: scales ECS instances in steps based on the specified thresholds and metric values.
PredictiveScalingRule: uses machine learning to analyze historical monitoring data of the scaling group and predicts the future values of metrics. In addition, Auto Scaling automatically creates scheduled tasks to adjust the boundary values for the scaling group
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩规则的类型。取值范围： 

SimpleScalingRule：简单规则。根据调整方式（AdjustmentType）和调整值（AdjustmentValue）调整ECS实例数量。
TargetTrackingScalingRule：目标追踪规则。根据预定义监控（MetricName）项动态计算需要扩缩容的ECS实例数量，尽量将预定义监控项的指标值维持在目标值（TargetValue）附近。
StepScalingRule：步进规则，根据阈值和指标值提供分步扩展方式。
PredictiveScalingRule：预测规则，基于机器学习能力分析伸缩组的历史监控数据预测未来监控指标值，并支持自动创建定时任务设置伸缩组边界
parameters.name: scaling_rule_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return the event-triggered tasks that are associated with the scaling rule. Valid values:

true
false

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否返回伸缩规则关联的云监控报警任务。取值范围：

true：返回伸缩规则关联的云监控报警任务。
false：不返回伸缩规则关联的云监控报警任务。

默认值：false
parameters.name: show_alarm_rules

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the scaling rules that you want to query
parameters.name: scaling_rule_ids

parameters.help_en: The names of the scaling rules that you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 待查询伸缩规则的名称
parameters.name: scaling_rule_names

parameters.help_en: The unique identifiers of the scaling rules that you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 待查询伸缩规则的唯一标识符
parameters.name: scaling_rule_aris
